label: Customer Support Resolution Agent
description: An agentic system that handles customer inquiries end-to-end: looks up order status, processes refunds, escalates complex issues, and maintains conversation context across multi-turn interactions. Integrates with CRM, order management, and payment systems via tools.

label: Code Generation with Claude Code
description: A developer using Claude Code to implement features, refactor existing code, write tests, and debug. Claude Code has file read/write access, can run shell commands, and operates inside a Git repository with CI/CD integration.

label: Multi-Agent Research System
description: An orchestrator that coordinates specialized subagents (literature search, data analysis, citation verification, summary writing, quality review) to produce comprehensive research reports. Uses hub-and-spoke pattern with a central orchestrator.

label: Developer Productivity with Claude
description: A team using Claude as a development assistant configured via CLAUDE.md files, custom slash commands, and MCP servers. Claude helps with code review, documentation, ticket triage, and project-specific workflows.

label: Claude Code for Continuous Integration
description: Claude Code integrated into a CI/CD pipeline to automatically review pull requests, check for security issues, validate documentation, and generate release notes. Runs non-interactively on every PR.

label: Structured Data Extraction
description: A pipeline that extracts structured information from unstructured documents (contracts, invoices, medical records) and outputs validated JSON. Uses schema definitions, validation-retry loops, and the Batch API for high-volume processing.
